trips.route_note: Take the MBTA Newburyport/Rockport commuter rail from North Station (about 30 minutes), then walk about 10 minutes into the downtown historic district.
see: Hawthorne Hotel and Essex Street shops
trips.why: The commuter rail from North Station takes about 32 minutes and drops you a short walk from the historic downtown.
know: October is the busiest and most crowded month, especially around Halloween

trips.route_note: Take the MBTA Fitchburg commuter rail from North Station (about 35-45 minutes) to Concord station, then walk or taxi about 1 to 2 miles to the Old North Bridge and center.

trips.tour_query: Concord and Lexington history day trip from Boston

know: The Old North Bridge is part of Minute Man National Historical Park

trips.route_note: Take an Amtrak or MBTA Providence/Stoughton train from South Station (about 35 minutes on Amtrak, up to an hour on the MBTA), then walk or take a short taxi to the downtown and State House.
trips.why: Amtrak from South Station takes about 39 minutes and reaches downtown, where the State House and historic districts are within walking distance.
know: WaterFire lighting events happen on select evenings during the warmer months
Trains are more frequent on the Amtrak route than on the MBTA service, so check schedules
